optional_codes.reason: Amlodipine is taken for hypertension, a chronic condition, so the long-term drug therapy code is supportable. The note does not state that it has been taken for an extended period, so the code is not required. Either answer is defensible.

citations.case: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.13.d.2 (a code from category M80, not a traumatic fracture code, is used for a patient with known osteoporosis who suffers a fracture, even after a minor fall); Section I.C.13.c (7th character A is for use as long as the patient is receiving active treatment for the fracture); ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, Excludes1 note at category M81 (osteoporosis with current pathological fracture is coded to M80.-), with Section I.A.12.a (an Excludes1 note means the excluded code is never used at the same time as the code above the note); Section II (principal diagnosis: the condition established after study to be chiefly responsible for the admission); Section III (other diagnoses: conditions that affect patient care by requiring evaluation, treatment or monitoring); Section I.C.20.a.1 (an external cause code may be used with a code for a health condition due to an external cause); Section I.B.5 (signs and symptoms associated routinely with a disease process are not assigned as additional codes); Section I.C.21.c.3 (category Z79 is assigned when a medication is taken for an extended period as treatment of a chronic condition)

coder_notes: The provider documents a pathological fracture of the right femoral neck due to age-related osteoporosis and states that the fracture is due to osteoporosis, not to the fall. One code from category M80 carries both the osteoporosis and the fracture; its site is the femur, and the 7th character A is used because she is admitted for initial treatment. The second listed diagnosis, age-related osteoporosis, is not coded separately: category M81 has an Excludes1 note for osteoporosis with current pathological fracture. No traumatic fracture code is used. The fall, the place and the activity are not coded, because the provider states the fracture is not due to the fall. Hypertension was managed during the admission (medication continued) and is reported. The long-term drug therapy code for amlodipine is accepted but not required, because the note does not say how long it has been taken (see optional_codes). Hip pain is a symptom of the fracture. Displacement has no axis in the code used. Traps: adding M81.0 with the M80 code; a traumatic femoral neck fracture code because of the fall; fall, place of occurrence or activity codes; a left-side or unspecified-side code; 7th character D
